messages:
elena_support: Heads up — several tenants reporting console hourly usage delayed ~3-5hrs. Noticed empty rows for hours 00:00-03:00 UTC for multiple customers.
omar_ingest: Checking consumer groups now. Saw a big rebalance on etl-consumer at 02:12 UTC, lag jumped to ~250k messages for consumer group 'hourly-rollup'.
jia_etl: Correlating with nightly maintenance — there was an offline schema change and a VACUUM FULL kicked off on metrics.hourly around 02:08. That blocked inserts for a few minutes and stalled CDC.
marta_db: Confirmed. A maintenance job (VACUUM FULL after ALTER TABLE) ran at 02:08 and held locks for ~7m, which caused the CDC streamer to back off. Writes queued.
nate_product: Customers are seeing '0' or stale numbers in console tiles. We have a handful of high-priority tickets (Acme, ClimateCo). ETA for recovery?
acme_ops: We're getting escalations from Acme. Can you provide timeline and repro so we can validate on our side?
deploy-bot: deploy:etl-replay v2.1 rolled at 03:30 UTC and scheduled backfill job 'hourly-replay-2026-03-17'.
omar_ingest: Kicking off incremental replay now with dedupe. Running targeted backfills for affected partitions first to avoid global pressure. Rough ETA ~2.5h for catch-up across all tenants.
elena_support: Request: can we add a console banner indicating delayed metrics? Users keep opening tickets without knowing it's system-side.
jia_etl: Workaround for support to run for a tenant: 
```bash
python tools/backfill_hours.py --tenant <tenant_id> --from 2026-03-17T00:00Z --to 2026-03-17T04:00Z --dedupe
```
Use --parallel 2 --batch-size 500 to limit DB impact.
marta_db: Note: bulk backfills can spike write amplification. DB team recommends limiting parallelism. We'll also avoid VACUUM FULL in future; plan to use pg_repack or scheduled maintenance windows.
omar_ingest: Applied consumer rate limit to 1000 msg/s and switched to small-batch mode to smooth pressure. Monitoring lag and DB p99.
elena_support: Also saw one tenant get a 403 on the console tile around 01:56 — any chance the auth rotation impacted ingestion retries?
jia_etl: 403 was a separate internal token rotation for telemetry at 01:55. Retries failed briefly but that didn't cause the large lag — primary cause remains the blocked writes from VACUUM FULL.
nate_product: Action items for post-incident: (1) targeted backfills for top-5 impacted customers, (2) add transient banner in console for delayed metrics, (3) postmortem with timeline + DB ops runbook.
elena_support: I'll post banner and update the active tickets with ETA and repro steps.
marta_db: DB team will reschedule heavy maintenance and push a guideline: avoid VACUUM FULL on metrics tables; use online approaches.
deploy-bot: backfill job 'hourly-replay-3777001234' finished for first wave (3 tenants) at 05:40 UTC — remaining tenants still queued.
jia_etl: After first wave finished those tenants' consoles started showing corrected hours. Monitoring for duplicate-upsert anomalies.
acme_ops: Received confirmation from Acme that their charts look normal for the corrected hours. Thanks.
elena_support: Final update for thread: partial backfill in progress, support banner up, targeted backfills running. Will loop in DB team for schedule changes.
